programs.name: Anthropic Fellows Program
programs.eligibility: No PhD, prior ML experience, or publications required
programs.note: Explicitly open to people without a research background. Also appears on our boards — Anthropic posts it to Greenhouse.

programs.name: OpenAI Residency
programs.eligibility: Cannot be enrolled in school. SF onsite 3+ days. Sponsorship offered.
programs.note: Rolling start dates. Does NOT appear on OpenAI's public job board — this is the only way to find it.

programs.name: Google DeepMind Student Researcher
programs.note: One application is considered across all Google AI teams.

programs.name: Google PhD Fellowship
programs.eligibility: UNIVERSITY-NOMINATED ONLY — you cannot apply directly
programs.note: Find out who nominates in your department, and ask early. This is a year-one decision, not a year-four one.

programs.name: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship
programs.eligibility: Requires ≥1 year of PhD study AND a prior in-person NVIDIA Research summer internship
programs.note: The internship prerequisite means you must plan two years out. Most people learn this too late.

programs.name: Meta AI Residency
programs.note: Page still reads 'applications are now closed' against a 2023 cohort. Listed so you know it exists and know not to wait for it.
